findings.title: The new trial serves incorrect warfarin-reversal guidance
findings.problem: The trial draws directly from QUESTIONS, which includes item 3: INR 4.8 without active bleeding, keyed to vitamin K plus holding warfarin. For INR 4.5–10 without bleeding, routine vitamin K is not recommended absent additional bleeding-risk considerations. Neither the stem nor rationale supplies those considerations, and there is no hold-warfarin-only choice.
findings.failure_scenario: A guest receives built-in question 3 and is taught that an asymptomatic INR of 4.8 routinely requires vitamin K.
findings.fix: Correct the built-in item's options, key, and rationale to distinguish holding warfarin from indications for vitamin K. Run the corrected item through the accuracy gate before including it in the guest pool.

findings.title: Signing out discards queued account progress
findings.problem: The sign-out handler invalidates the save queue before draining it. createSaveQueue skips tasks whose sequence is no longer current, so the latest answer can be deliberately dropped rather than saved.
findings.failure_scenario: An earlier autosave is still in flight. The student answers another question, queuing the updated blob, then taps Sign out. invalidate() makes that queued write stale; only the earlier blob reaches the server, and the latest answer, XP, ability update, and review date are lost.
findings.fix: Stop new edits, drain or explicitly save the latest account-bound payload, and await its result before signing out. Surface a failure with an explicit choice to retry or leave without saving. Add a delayed-write regression test that verifies the final answer survives sign-out.

findings.title: Failed guest storage is silently presented as saved progress
findings.problem: saveGuest returns false when localStorage.setItem fails, but this effect ignores the result. The trial and authentication screens still claim the answers are saved on the device and will move into the account. There is no in-memory handoff when GuestTrial unmounts.
findings.failure_scenario: Device storage is full or writes are blocked. A visitor completes the trial and selects Create free account. GuestTrial unmounts, no guest blob is available for loadProgress, and all trial answers disappear despite the save confirmation.
findings.fix: Track whether the trial was actually persisted and never show the saved claim after a failed write. Preserve the in-memory trial through authentication or block the handoff with a clear retry/export option until persistence succeeds. Test a storage implementation whose setItem throws.

findings.title: Rapid repeat answers still build correct runs
findings.problem: answerXp returns reason "repeat" before checking the reading-time floor. App.record and guestAnswer decide whether to extend a run using correct && reason !== "too-fast", so a rapid correct repeat is treated as a considered answer.
findings.failure_scenario: A student replays a previously correct case or answers a previously corrected scheduled question in 100 ms. The result is "repeat", not "too-fast"; the app increments the run and can announce a combo or save a new best run, contradicting its stated rapid-tap safeguard.
findings.fix: Evaluate whether the answer meets the time floor independently of XP eligibility, and use that result when updating runs. Add a regression test with a prior correct log entry and an elapsed time below minThinkMs that asserts the run does not increase.

assessment: Changes are required before release. The new guest trial exposes incorrect anticoagulation guidance, two persistence paths can lose progress, and rapid repeat answers bypass the new run-counting safeguard. Tests were not run.
